line: Crowley attributes Disks to Earth. The Ace gives the suit Hé final, the Daughter, while his general account gives Earth the letter Tau.

sections.title: Earth as a whirling disk
sections.line: Crowley sets the suit's Earth against the old view of Earth as a passive element, and says the Disks are not coins.

quotes.quote: Nor are the Disks any more to be considered as Coins; the Disk is a whirling emblem.
the old conception of the Earth as a passive, immobile, even dead, even “evil” element, had to go.

sections.title: The Daughter on the Mother's throne
sections.line: The letter is given in the text of the Ace of Disks, and the suits are tied to the four elements in his diagram.

quotes.quote: the Earthy component, Hé final, the Daughter, is set upon the Throne of the Mother
This diagram shows the attribution of the four Suits of the pack to the four Elements.

sections.title: The letter of Earth
sections.line: Crowley's general account gives Earth the letter Tau, which he also gives the Universe card. The Ace of Disks gives Hé final. The page states both, and does not reconcile them.

quotes.quote: represented by the last letter of the alphabet, Tau.
the element of earth was thrust upon the symbol.
